hardware: Apple M4 Max, 40 Metal GPU cores, 48 GiB unified memory
model: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Q4_K_M, BF16 KV, BF16 DFlash2 sidecar, max draft depth 6
protocol: One diagnostic binary, same target and draft weights and grouped BF16 attention in all configurations. Prefill uses the first 36 direct MoE layers plus the same wide-prefill setting. Only generation can reference the last four loaded banks. For each case, a fresh process for two timing requests with GPU counters disabled and a separate fresh process for one Metal trace/full-logit snapshot. Warmup 15/8 then uncached 4000/64, greedy temperature 0 and seed 42. OS page cache uncontrolled. Launches sequential.

metric_boundaries.whole_verify: Target llama_process through existing llama_synchronize, wall clock. Excludes draft generation and accept/commit. No GPU timestamp profiling in these samples.
metric_boundaries.ffn_by_layer: Elapsed interval from first tagged FFN Metal work or CPU callback entry through last tagged FFN Metal work or callback return. Includes post-attention norm, router, routed and shared FFN, and FFN residual, including host handoffs. GPU counter clock mapped to host monotonic time. Attention and GDN mixer excluded. Callback times include nested GPU work and waits.
metric_boundaries.tps: 63 / (last token event minus first token event). No GPU profiling or logit dump in these samples. Includes drafting and acceptance.
metric_boundaries.peak: Process lifetime physical footprint from proc_pid_rusage and separate managed-ledger high water. The ledger includes the charged runtime reservation and marks placement eligibility.
